title: India's AI data centre boom sparks protests over water, power and environmental concerns
key_facts: The Hindu video page says Amazon, Google and Microsoft are investing billions in data centres across India.
Residents near the facilities are raising concerns over water consumption, electricity demand, noise and the loss of green spaces.
Communities and environmentalists from Mumbai to Andhra Pradesh are questioning the impact of the projects.
quote_evidence: Residents near these facilities are raising concerns over water consumption, electricity demand, noise and the loss of green spaces.
why_it_matters_hint: Local opposition to data centres is growing in India (video description only).
